facts.anchor: gazing through the fenestrations of a Monstera deliciosa
facts.fact: Saskia 站在凸窗边，透过龟背竹（Monstera deliciosa）的叶隙观望，等 Roger 离开；她不想让 Roger 知道两人交好。

facts.anchor: before opening it and pawing through whatever he finds within
facts.fact: Roger 在 Saskia 与 Lucy 共用的邮箱前四下张望，开箱翻掏里面的东西。

facts.anchor: Saskia has sixty-three plants in her apartment
facts.fact: Saskia 公寓里有 63 株植物，每株她都熟悉，但植物不是人，不会照顾她、也不回报她。

facts.anchor: heads back up to Lucy’s apartment, locking the deadbolt behind her
facts.fact: Saskia 拿着芦荟叶回到 Lucy 的公寓，反锁门闩，上楼时喊 “It’s me!”。

facts.anchor: He let himself in. I thought he was you. I was changing. He saw.
facts.fact: Lucy 告诉 Saskia：Roger 自己进来了，她当时正在换衣服，被他看到。

facts.anchor: I had plenty of chargers and I’d add ten dollars to next month’s rent
facts.fact: Lucy 说已跟 Roger 讲自己有很多充电器、会在下月房租里加 10 美元赔偿；Saskia 边听边用芦荟给她涂背。

facts.anchor: Then Saskia remembers she shouldn’t be touching Lucy at all—
facts.fact: Saskia 想起自己不该碰 Lucy，抽回手，说 “I’ve got to get back to work.”。

facts.anchor: “What is this?” Lucy holds up a tiny seed trailing a green tendril.
facts.fact: Lucy 要 Saskia 坐下喝汤，凑近她的脸，用指甲从 Saskia 眼角刮出一粒拖着绿色卷须的种子，问 “What is this?”。
